selection: Preserved original IDS pilot followed by geographically targeted public HTML batches.
source_scope: Public product catalogue only; not all independently verified craft, current availability or production locations.
field_provenance: Original 1000 records retain genuine IDS provenance. Expansion records explicitly state direct_public_html and their source-page hash.

batches.selection: Purposively selected geographically spread breweries, native list order, per-page IDS exports. First target unique IDs are retained in manifest order; not a global random sample.
batches.source_scope: Public product catalogue only; not all independently verified craft, current availability or production locations.

batches.selection: Geographically targeted breweries; at most two ordinary public HTML pages per brewery. No login or private API. Includes source-listed beers without candidate images; no claim of independent-craft certification.

regional_batches.selection: Geographically targeted breweries; at most two ordinary public HTML pages per brewery. No login or private API. Includes source-listed beers without candidate images; no claim of independent-craft certification.

Up to first two public 15-item list pages per researched brewery, at most 30 records per brewery. Existing imported UUIDs and explicit cider/mead are excluded. This is a geographic convenience sample, not exhaustive or random.
Geographically selected public brewery listings. Brewery craft certification unknown; industrial_reference entries explicitly qualified. No login/private API or remote image download.

batches.selection: Requested Georgia (country), New Zealand, mainland China, India and multiple African countries. Preserve prior 1432 records. Source IDs deduplicated; locality references reviewed separately; no production-site claim.

regional_batches.selection: Geographically targeted breweries; at most one ordinary public HTML page per brewery. No login or private API. Includes source-listed beers without candidate images; no claim of independent-craft certification.

First public 15-item list page per researched brewery, at most 15 records per brewery. Existing imported UUIDs and explicit cider/mead are excluded. This is a geographic convenience sample, not exhaustive or random.

batches.selection: New city references across the Americas, Africa, Eurasia and Oceania, prioritizing geographic gaps. Preserve prior 1848 records. Source IDs deduplicated; locality references reviewed separately; no production-site claim.

regional_batches.selection: One public first page per new brewery, selected for image/description overlap; all page rows retained. Paper Plane is a China geographic exception with 2 pictured descriptions; missing descriptions are not synthesized.

batches.selection: New city references across the Americas, Africa, Eurasia and Oceania, prioritizing geographic gaps. Preserve prior 2372 records. Source IDs deduplicated; locality references reviewed separately; no production-site claim.
